entities.summary: The Allied Museum is a museum in Berlin. It documents the political history and the military commitments and roles of the Western Allies in Germany – particularly Berlin – between 1945 and 1994 and their contribution to liberty in Berlin during the Cold War era. Allied Museum is a military museum in Europe, established in 1996. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
